text:
Maya (CS): hey team :wave: kickoff for Xenta dedicated pool bring-up. Priya signed yesterday — renewal hinge is a smooth go-live. need quota plan, autoscale policy, and a 30m enablement for their infra team. can we sync?
Sam (Solutions): congrats Priya! what steady qps and burst shape? Priya, drop traffic template pls.
Priya (Customer): steady ~120 qps, ~90% short (<150 tokens). marketing spikes: bursts to ~900 qps for ~10m. streaming chat used heavily.
Devon (SRE): recommend reserved_capacity=12 GPUs, autoscale_policy=burst-thermostat-v2, max_burst=1.5x. warm-chain required: 2h priming then 30m ramp to spike in shadow. enable cross-pool fallback.
Li (ML Ops): streaming affects kernels. plan two variants: m-open-8q (low-latency) and m-open-8q-stable (fallback). use prefix caching for chat. quant_profile: q4_0 steady, q3_k fallback.
Sam (Solutions): runbook checklist: quota sheet to finance, shadow soak failover tests, 30m enablement, rollback play. I'll draft ops checklist.
Maya (CS): Priya — confirm VPC + AWS KMS details (affects onboarding window).
Priya (Customer): yes VPC. KMS via AWS account x-999. security will join enablement.
Devon (SRE): loadbot schedule: warm-chain then shadow-run Wed 03:00 UTC. loadbot please.
loadbot: scheduled shadow-run 2024-11-06T03:00:00Z id=xb-shad-6181. Results will post to #customer-success.
Sam (Solutions): shadow parameters: steady_qps=120, burst_peak=900, duration=10m, warmup=2h, metrics=p50,p95,tokens/s,gpu_util, script=scripts/xenta_stream_chat.json
Maya (CS): risk: renewal meeting in 3w. if p95 > 800ms during soak they may request discount. prioritize dashboards and alerts.
Li (ML Ops): I'll provide cache warmers and sample prompts; add feature-flag for routing to avoid app changes.
Devon (SRE): ops: set burst_capacity=150%, autoscale_cooldown=45s, quota_alerts at 70/90% with paging at 95%. tag team=xenta urgency=high. will post terraform snippet after enablement.
Sam (Solutions): enablement Thu 10:00 UTC (30m) — will send invites.
Priya (Customer): Thu works; security x2 joining.
Maya (CS): actions: Sam=ops checklist+calendar, Devon=terraform+runbook, Li=cache warmers+routing creds, Priya=KMS IAM+IP whitelist. I'll log in renewal tracker.
Devon (SRE): note: fallback strategy tested in failover run. escalate to eng-runtime if regressions.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing loop — will update account health doc after shadow run and enablement.
Priya (Customer): thanks team, excited to go live.
